headline: ML / AI ENGINEER | DATA ANALYST
summary: ML/AI Engineer and Data Analyst with nearly 4 years of experience building automated data pipelines, machine learning models, and business intelligence solutions. Built and deployed a churn-prediction model on a 112,650-row e-commerce dataset and designed end-to-end data workflows from raw data ingestion (PostgreSQL, MySQL) through cleaning, multi-table integration, feature engineering, and automated EDA report generation. Skilled in translating complex datasets into clear, actionable KPI visualizations and ML-ready features for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Currently completing intensive training in Deep Learning, NLP, Transformers, LLMs, and RAG architectures through a 60-session AI/ML/DS program (LogicMojo, through Sep 2026) and the IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate.
